A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same DoLQ research work, with complete, readable main text and Appendices A–K. Each has 39 pages; pages 2–39 have identical extracted text and rendered appearance.

before.justification: v1 reports original experiments on eight ODE systems, including numerical accuracy, symbolic recovery, component ablations, robustness tests, and efficiency measurements.

after.justification: v2 retains the same original experimental results in Sections 4–5 and the appendices, including benchmark comparisons and robustness analyses.

M1.justification: The Sampler Agent, Parameter Optimizer, Scientist Agent, hybrid optimization, and term-retention procedures are identical in Section 3 and Appendix B.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same eight ODE systems and retain the same extended-domain, shifted-initial-condition, observation-noise, and description-noise scenarios.

E2.justification: ICSR, LASR, LLM-SR, and EDL retain identical participation in the main and appendix comparisons. The component-comparison variants also remain unchanged.

E3.justification: Data generation, ID/ID-Ext regimes, residual and integral NMSE metrics, search budgets, model configurations, and supplementary evaluation procedures are unchanged.

E4.justification: Section 5 retains the same Scientist Agent and optimizer analyses. The appendices preserve the same optimizer-adoption, initial-condition, backbone, noise, reasoning-trace, and efficiency analyses.

E5.justification: Section 5.1 retains the policy of reporting the best of three runs unless otherwise noted. Appendix G.1 retains the same averaging across initial conditions; uncertainty reporting is unchanged.

E6.justification: All numerical results, discovered equations, and qualitative findings are unchanged, including appendix results. Figure 4 and Table 13 report the same DoLQ totals: seven of eight NMSE-test successes and five of eight term-test successes.

T1.justification: The problem formulation, objective equations, and mathematical definitions are identical. Appendix I retains the same time-complexity assumptions and derivations.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions and claims concerning integrated qualitative–quantitative evaluation, discovery performance, and symbolic recovery.

C2.justification: Mechanism explanations and limitations remain identical, including measurement-noise sensitivity, reasoning fixation, dependence on accurate descriptions, and difficulties extending to PDEs.

D1.justification: The code-access link, data-generation instructions, hyperparameters, prompts, hardware information, and runtime disclosures are unchanged in the main text and appendices.

R1.justification: The cited works, reference list, and positioning relative to symbolic regression and LLM-based scientific discovery are identical.

P1.justification: The first-page affiliation changes from Daejin University, Pocheon to Department of AI Big Data, Daejin University, Pocheon-si. Author-marker spacing and the arXiv version/date line also change; scientific prose and document structure remain identical.

P2.justification: The revised affiliation causes limited first-page footnote reflow, and author-marker spacing and the marginal arXiv stamp change visually. Figures, tables, and all subsequent page layouts are identical.

improvement.justification: v2 makes the affiliation more specific and updates first-page metadata and formatting. The scientific text, results, figures, tables, and appendices remain unchanged, so these administrative edits do not materially alter the paper's evidential strength, clarity, or reproducibility.
